senses.sense_definition: A hammer with a large, usually wooden or rubber head, used especially for hitting chisels or driving pegs without damaging the surface.

examples.text: He used a rubber <w>mallet</w> to secure the wooden joints without leaving marks.
We needed a heavy <w>mallet</w> to drive the metal tent pegs firmly into the dry ground.

senses.sense_definition: A long-handled wooden stick used to hit the ball in games such as croquet.

examples.text: She swung the croquet <w>mallet</w> and sent her ball through the wire hoop.
Each player grabbed a colored <w>mallet</w> before the croquet match began on the lawn.

senses.sense_definition: A stick with a rounded head of felt, wood, or plastic, used to strike percussion instruments such as xylophones or timpani.

examples.text: The percussionist held a soft <w>mallet</w> in each hand to produce warm tones on the marimba.
Striking the xylophone bar too hard with a hard <w>mallet</w> can damage the instrument.

senses.sense_definition: A long, flexible stick with a cigar-shaped head used by a rider to strike the ball in polo.

examples.text: The polo player swung his polo <w>mallet</w> with great precision from the saddle.
He broke his favorite <w>mallet</w> during the final chukker of the polo match.

senses.sense_definition: A heavy weapon resembling a mallet, typically swung with two hands in medieval warfare.

examples.text: The knight wielded a massive war <w>mallet</w> designed to crush heavy armor.
Historical records describe soldiers armed with a lead-weighted <w>mallet</w> on the battlefield.

senses.sense_definition: A type of articulated steam locomotive with two sets of driving wheels, named after its inventor Anatole Mallet.

examples.text: The railway company relied on an articulated <w>Mallet</w> to haul heavy coal trains across the mountains.
They admired the preserved <w>Mallet</w> locomotive resting outside the historic train station.

senses.sense_definition: To strike or beat with, or as if with, a mallet.

examples.text: The soldier <w>malleted</w> the intruder with the butt of his rifle.
He angrily <w>malleted</w> the stuck machinery until the metal frame finally bent.

senses.sense_definition: A conventional name for an active malicious attacker in cryptography and security scenario examples.

examples.text: In this network security diagram, <w>Mallet</w> alters the transmission sent between Alice and Bob.
The cryptographer explained how <w>Mallet</w> could intercept messages and inject counterfeit data into the stream.
